instruction: Pick the onion from the sink and place it on the plate located on the counter.
note: The object lies in the sink basin, below the counter; the plate (container) is on the counter beside the sink. Grasp from above around the object's middle height, lift clear of the counter, transport in short steps, lower until just above the plate, release, then move the gripper more than 25 cm away. A first attempt that grasped 3 cm above the middle dropped the object during a fast 20 cm sideways move.
